text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I won.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I won the G1 race to decide the ruler of
the
sprint... I won the Takamatsunomiya
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Dang, Kawakami Princess is good.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I knew King Halo was old news!
Maybe now
she'll finally move on.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh... no...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (If I won, that means King...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Why are you looking so glum?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry, King. Because of me, you...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I hope you're not going to apologize for
hurting
my feelings or some other
nonsense.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Don't be naive. This is a world of victory
and
defeat—a place where you crush the
dreams of
another to fulfill your own.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, even outside of this competitive
world, it's
impossible to truly make your
mark without
risking something in return.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just as there can only be one King Halo,
nobody
can be the same as another
person.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
King... How could you lose? I thought
you'd win
for sure...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It means she's past her prime. It's pitiful,
honestly.
Stop fighting for the spotlight
and make way for
the newer generation.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm sure it's hard to watch... from
your point
of view.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However, I am proud that I chose to
enter this
race, and I do not feel I was
selfish in the
slightest!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Because I believe this was the choice
that best
represents who I am!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much you try, you'll
never make
me feel ashamed.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
How can I regret my actions if I was only
being
true to myself? Would that not be
the most
ridiculous notion of all?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I am King Halo, a first-rate Umamusume!
And I
will live the way only I can.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Um... King!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes, Kawakami?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I'm... sorry about before! I...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It's fine to feel remorse if you are
ashamed about
your actions...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However, don't be afraid of rejection or
hurting
others' feelings.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Always listen to your own heart—not
what anyone
else has to say.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Is what you're doing something
shameful, or is it
something you can take
pride in?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you can't distinguish between being

self-centered and being yourself, then
you won't
be able to express anything at
all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Being self-centered and being myself...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If the day ever comes when we compete
again, I'll
go all out and give you a good
thrashing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I won't hold back, no matter my
opponent. That's
how I stay true to
myself and how I show respect
to those
who challenge me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I won't lose next time, Kawakami.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Right!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. The answer was within me
all
along.
choice_data_list: ……Did you figure out how to draw the 'ideal'?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some days later, Kawakami Princess
comes to me
with a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Before the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
King asked
me whether I felt pride in
myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whether I could take pride in my own
actions.
Whether they reflect my true
self.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King's words made me realize
something—staying
true to myself
doesn't mean I'm being
self-centered. So
I'll keep on moving forward...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone else might think
of me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, for next month's Fan Fest, I
want to take
part in this event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess shows me a plan for a
stage
event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Last Year's Tiara Tour in Retrospect!" A
talk
show presented by glamorous
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It seems the Umamusume I competed
against last
year will be there, as well as
all their fans.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess wouldn't back down from
an
opportunity like this just because she
felt
intimidated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see sincere determination burning in
her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But somewhere deeper, I sense a subtle
tremor, a
trembling accompanied by an
eagerness to grow.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Right.
